scholarships.title: Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: KU Leuven (financed by the KU Leuven International Scholarship Fund)

existing.description: KU Leuven's centrally funded master's scholarship, financed by donations to the KU Leuven International Scholarship Fund. For the 2026-2027 academic year one scholarship was available, awarded to an outstanding applicant to any eligible KU Leuven master's or advanced master's programme. Holders receive a full tuition fee waiver, pay only an annual administration fee of circa EUR 140, and receive an allowance of EUR 13,200 per academic year for a maximum of two academic years. One application covers this scholarship together with the Master Mind, ASEAN, Africa and Central and South America scholarships.
eligibility: Study level: master's programmes (a restricted list of eligible programmes is published for each academic year).
The student has a high level of academic performance and potential; excellent study results reflected in a high Grade Point Average on the transcript of records.

Previous degree(s) should have been obtained at a higher education institution outside Flanders; international students who completed a credit mobility programme at a host Flemish higher education institution remain eligible.

Students already enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution are not eligible (only exception: international students enrolled in a specific preparatory programme who apply in the spring before starting the master's in September).
Students may not combine the Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship with any other scholarship.

Applicants whose first language is not English must meet the English requirement; English-taught degree holders from Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or the USA are exempt.
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities; applicants must be applying to an eligible KU Leuven master's or advanced master's programme, must have a high academic performance and potential, and their previous degree(s) should have been obtained outside Flanders. Applicants whose first language is not English must prove a good command of English (Online TOEFL 94, IELTS 7, or Cambridge CPE C2).
benefits: Study allowance of EUR 13,200 per academic year (maximum two academic years)
Automatic consideration for the Master Mind Scholarship and the KU Leuven ASEAN, Africa and Central and South America Scholarships through the same application
coverage: Full tuition fee waiver for the eligible master's programme
Monthly/yearly study allowance of EUR 13,200 per academic year, for a maximum of two academic years
Only an annual administration fee of circa EUR 140 remains payable by the scholarship holder
requirements: Take the English language test before the application deadline of 15 January; results may be added after the deadline.
Submit a complete programme application file and the Candidacy Form annexe before 15 January 2026, 23.59 CET.
Register the scholarship candidacy through the online registration tool before 15 January 2026, 23.59 CET.
If nominated, be ready to submit a one-minute motivational video for the central selection phase.
documents: Complete application file for an eligible KU Leuven master's programme, submitted through the KU Leuven application tool
KU Leuven Scholarships & Master Mind Candidacy Form, uploaded as an 'Annexe' in the application tool
Proof of English language proficiency (Online TOEFL, IELTS or Cambridge CPE) unless exempt
existing.english_requirement: Online TOEFL minimum overall score 94, IELTS minimum overall score 7, or Cambridge CPE minimum level C2.
application_method: Step 1: Submit a complete application file for an eligible master's programme before the deadline, including the KU Leuven Scholarships & Master Mind Candidacy Form uploaded as an annexe.
Step 2: Register the scholarship candidacy via the KU Leuven online registration tool before the deadline.
After nomination: submit a one-minute motivational video for the central selection phase.
existing.selection_notes: KU Leuven master's programmes first nominate eligible students who expressed interest in the scholarship; nominated students are informed by 10 March 2026 and asked for a one-minute motivational video. The central KU Leuven Selection Committee then makes the final selection, with results announced at the end of March or the beginning of April.
existing.best_fit: High-performing applicants with a strong academic record who hold or are close to holding a first degree from outside Flanders and can satisfy the English requirement; eligible for all KU Leuven master's and advanced master's programmes in the published eligible list.
existing.notes: Only one scholarship was available for the 2026-2027 academic year. The same single application also grants access to the Master Mind Scholarship and the KU Leuven ASEAN, Africa and Central and South America Scholarships (all-nation or nationality-conditioned variants).
existing.application_period: Applications open in early October and close 15 January, 23.59 CET, for entry the following academic year (2026-2027 cycle: opened 15 October 2025, closed 15 January 2026).
existing.deadline_display: Application deadline 15 January 2026, 23.59 CET (2026-2027 entry); applications opened 15 October 2025.
